A new passenger on its way to the International Space Station! 🚀 The ClimCam payload, a climate monitoring camera, has been successfully launched Cape Canaveral in Florida. This deployment marks a key achievement for the joint initiative between the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (@UNOOSA) and Airbus, who granted a free one-year mission aboard the ISS to support the @UN’s Sustainable Development Goals. The very heart of ClimCam is international cooperation.The joint project between Uganda, Egypt, and Kenya was designed to monitor the impacts of climate change in Eastern Africa. For 12 months, the mission will focus on collecting and sharing information and images from space to guide climate mitigation efforts on the ground, boost the agricultural sector, and help build a more sustainable future.🌱 The next step: integration on Bartolomeo, the Airbus payload platform aboard the ISS.

The two leaders exchanged views on the recently concluded Islamabad Talks and the direct U.S.–Iran negotiations. He reaffirmed the People’s Republic of China’s continued support for Pakistan’s constructive diplomatic role. DPM/FM reiterated Pakistan’s steadfast commitment to advancing dialogue and diplomacy as the preferred means to restore peace in the region. NITI Aayog, in partnership with National Skill Development Corporation, has signed a Statement of Intent to advance women-led enterprises in Uttar Pradesh, with implementation anchored through the Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP). The SoI was exchanged in the presence of Shri Yogi Adityanath, Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh; Shri Jayant Chaudhary, Minister of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India; Shri Kapil Dev Agarwal, Minister of Skill Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh; and other dignitaries. The exchange was carried out by Ms. Anna Roy, Programme Director, NITI Aayog and Mission Director, WEP, and Shri Arun Kumar Pillai, CEO, National Skill Development Corporation. The collaboration will focus on strengthening women-led enterprises across the state through entrepreneurship-focused skilling, access to compliant infrastructure, credit linkages, and market integration. Adopting a cluster-based approach, the initiative seeks to enable women associated with Self-Help Groups to transition from participation to enterprise ownership. The initiative to strengthen women-led enterprises is integral to India’s growth trajectory, with convergence of skilling, finance, and market access enabling expanded opportunities for women entrepreneurs. Leveraging Uttar Pradesh’s extensive SHG network and enabling policy ecosystem, the partnership seeks to accelerate women’s economic participation and generate sustained socio-economic outcomes. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #WEP #WomenEntrepreneurship #SkillDevelopment #UttarPradesh #InclusiveGrowth

Strengthening Cooperative Federalism Shri Rohit Kumar, Additional Secretary, led a NITI Aayog delegation in a detailed meeting with the Rajasthan Institution for Transformation and Innovation (RITI), Government of Rajasthan, under the State Support Mission. In the presence of the CEO, RITI and officials from the Planning and other state departments, the team reviewed key activities undertaken by RITI across several flagship programmes, including the State Support Mission, NITI for States Platform, Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP), and Aspirational Blocks Programme (ABP). The discussions focused on assessing the progress made, evaluating the on-ground impact of these initiatives, and outlining a future roadmap to strengthen NITI–State collaboration for accelerating inclusive growth in Rajasthan. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #COOPERATIVEFEDERALISM #StateSupportMission #ADP #ABP #NITIforStates #Rajasthan

ग्रेटर नोएडा और नोएडा में मजदूरों का गंभीर शोषण हो रहा है, और ऊपर से पुलिस द्वारा भी अत्याचार किए जा रहे हैं। अगर तोड़-फोड़ और रास्ता जाम जैसी घटनाएँ हो रही हैं, तो इसके लिए नोएडा प्रशासन जिम्मेदार है, क्योंकि लंबे समय से मजदूरों की मांगों को नजरअंदाज किया जा रहा है। मजदूर कई वर्षों से वेतन और अन्य सुविधाओं की मांग कर रहे हैं, लेकिन उनकी बात सुनने वाला कोई नहीं है। मजबूर होकर उन्हें आंदोलन का रास्ता अपनाना पड़ रहा है। मजदूरों से 12–12 घंटे काम कराया जा रहा है, जबकि उन्हें केवल 10–11 हजार रुपये वेतन दिया जा रहा है और छुट्टियाँ भी नहीं मिलतीं। प्रबंधन जब चाहता है, उन्हें नौकरी से निकाल देता है। समय पर वेतन नहीं दिया जाता और काम के बदले कम भुगतान किया जाता है। कार्यस्थल पर सुरक्षा की कमी है, और काम के घंटों को निर्धारित करने की भी आवश्यकता है। मजदूर महंगाई के अनुसार वेतन बढ़ाने की मांग कर रहे हैं। हरियाणा की तर्ज पर नोएडा में भी अकुशल श्रमिकों के लिए ₹15,000 से अधिक और कुशल श्रमिकों के लिए ₹19,000 से अधिक मासिक वेतन की मांग की जा रही है। Staunch Electronics (स्टॉन्च इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स), Richa Global (रिचा ग्लोबल), Motherson (मदरसन) और Spark Minda (स्पार्क मिंडा) कंपनियों पर शोषण के आरोप सबसे अधिक हैं। इन कंपनियों के शीर्ष प्रबंधन और मालिकों के खिलाफ तत्काल कार्रवाई की जानी चाहिए, और मजदूरों को उनका उचित वेतन, सुरक्षा और अन्य सुविधाएं प्रदान की जानी चाहिए। @ANI @PTI @ians_india Video

دونالد ترامپ، رییس‌جمهور امریکا پس از آغاز محاصره‌ی دریایی بنادر ایران در خلیج فارس و دریای عمان هشدار داده است که اگر «قایق‌‌های تهاجمی پرسرعت» ایران به منطقه‌ی تحت محاصره نزدیک شوند، فورا نابود می‌شوند. ترامپ با نشر پستی در تروث‌سوشیال نوشته است که این قایق‌ها با استفاده از همان سیستم کشتاری که علیه قاچاقچیان مواد مخدر در قایق‌ها در دریا استفاده شده، «سریع و بی‌رحمانه» نابود خواهد شد. رییس‌جمهور امریکا گفته است که ۱۸۵ کشتی ایران در کف دریا قرار دارند و کاملا نابود شده‌اند، اما آنچه باقی‌مانده تعداد اندک قایق‌های تهاجمی سریع است که امریکا آن را تهدید بزرگی نمی‌دانسته است. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/252028

ریاست هواشناسی وزارت ترانسپورت و هوانوردی طالبان احتمال بارش باران و سرازیرشدن سیلاب‌ را در ۱۴ ولایت کشور پیش‌بینی کرده است. براساس پیش‌بینی این ریاست، فردا (سه‌شنبه، ۲۵ حمل) ولایت‌های جوزجان، فاریاب، سرپل، غور، دایکندی، بامیان، بغلان، سمنگان، بلخ، تخار، بدخشان، میدان وردک، پکتیا و خوست شاهد بارندگی خواهند بود. این ریاست میزان بارندگی را در نقاط مختلف این ولایت‌ها بین ۱۰ تا ۲۵ میلی‌متر پیش‌بینی کرده است. ریاست هواشناسی طالبان همچنین وزش باد با سرعت ۵۰ تا ۸۰ کیلومتر در ساعت را در ولایت‌های شمالی، شمال‌غربی، غربی و مرکزی کشور پیش‌بینی کرده است.

حدود ۴۰ دختر در اتاق درسی گرد هم آمده‌اند که پرده‌های ضخیم بر دروازه و پنجره‌های آن کشیده شده‌اند. تصاویر دوربین‌های مداربسته‌ی بیرون از خانه به‌صورت هم‌زمان در داخل پخش می‌شوند تا در صورت نزدیک شدن افراد ناشناس یا نیروهای طالبان، مسئولان و دانش‌آموزان مرکز به‌ سرعت آگاه شوند. فضای صنف به‌گونه‌ای تنظیم شده که فعالیت آموزشی آن از نگاه‌ها دور بماند و رفت‌وآمدها جلب توجه نکند. این یکی از مراکز آموزش مضامین مکتب در شهر مزار شریف، مرکز ولایت بلخ در شمال افغانستان است (با تمرکز بر زبان انگلیسی و کمپیوتر برای دختران). اطلاعات روز از ارائه‌ی جزئیات بیشتر درباره‌ی موقعیت این مرکز خودداری می‌کند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/252025

A new passenger on its way to the International Space Station! 🚀 The ClimCam payload, a climate monitoring camera, has been successfully launched Cape Canaveral in Florida. This deployment marks a key achievement for the joint initiative between the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (@UNOOSA) and Airbus, who granted a free one-year mission aboard the ISS to support the @UN’s Sustainable Development Goals. The very heart of ClimCam is international cooperation.The joint project between Uganda, Egypt, and Kenya was designed to monitor the impacts of climate change in Eastern Africa. For 12 months, the mission will focus on collecting and sharing information and images from space to guide climate mitigation efforts on the ground, boost the agricultural sector, and help build a more sustainable future.🌱 The next step: integration on Bartolomeo, the Airbus payload platform aboard the ISS.

West Bengal SIR: The Supreme Court has verbally remarked that the people whose names have been excluded from the voter list and whose appeals are pending to be adjudicated before the Appellate Tribunals would be allowed to vote if their names are included after final adjudication. A bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Joymalya Bagchi made the verbal observations after it was informed by the counsels appearing for the petitioner West Bengal government, that the names of 34 lakh people have been excluded from the voter list. “The Judicial Officers have completed the adjudication by April 9 — even if they had exceeded by 1–2 days, I have given them the permission (to adjudicate further claims). There are 153 constituencies — there was some spillover of 7–8 constituencies — those names that were left out would be added to the list for the April 23 elections. Don’t worry — if their names are there, they will be voting. At this stage, Senior Advocate and AITC MP Kalyan Banerjee submitted that 16 lakhs appeals have been filed (in the appellate tribunal) seeking inclusion and asked how it would be even possible to adjudicate all those claims. The CJI responded that if that’s the scenario as being submitted by the petitioners, then what should the Court do? “Those who have been allowed, should we even stay the names included”, the CJI remarked, implying that if the petitioners keep on objecting to the SIR process, how would the elections take place.

The Specialized Environmental Prosecutor’s Office is seeking, through the courts, the return to the state of land in the Vyshhorod district that was affected by the Chornobyl disaster. According to the investigation, crops have been grown there for five years, the Office of the Prosecutor General reported. According to the prosecutor’s office, three land plots with a total area of over 190 hectares were previously used by the state agency responsible for managing the exclusion zone. However, state registrars, according to the investigation, illegally changed their status and transferred them to municipal ownership. Subsequently, the right to use the land was unjustifiably transferred to a private company. Since 2020, all these territories have been used for growing crops, including wheat and corn. The prosecutor’s office emphasizes that this poses a risk to human life and health.

Macroeconomic stability is increasingly shaped by shocks that begin far from financial centers, including in rural areas, where a single health event can disrupt global supply chains and trigger trillions in economic losses. 60% of infectious diseases originate in animals, placing rural communities on the frontlines of global health risks. Yet a single outbreak, no matter how remote, can cascade through supply chains and result in trillions of dollars in lost GDP. IFAD’s experience shows that targeted rural investments can simultaneously strengthen health security and economic resilience. Since 2010, IFAD has invested over US$6 billion in more than 100 livestock projects, improving animal health, strengthening disease surveillance, and increasing smallholder incomes. The results are measurable: in #Kyrgyzstan, IFAD‑financed mobile veterinary services contributed to a decline in human brucellosis cases from 4,412 in 2011 to fewer than 500 in 2020. In #Tanzania, access to animal health services led to a 69% increase in livestock income, demonstrating how health and productivity gains go hand in hand. With its recent accreditation as an implementing entity of the Pandemic Fund, IFAD is scaling this work – bringing a #OneHealth approach that links human, animal, and ecosystem health directly to the rural systems where risks emerge. مسئولان محلی طالبان در ننگرهار می‌گویند که یک کودک ۱۳ ساله در ولسوالی بهسود این ولایت هنگام آب‌بازی غرق شده و جان باخته است. قریشی بدلون، آمر اطلاعات ریاست اطلاعات و فرهنگ طالبان در ننگرهار گفته است که این رویداد دیروز (یک‌شنبه، ۲۳ حمل) در ساحه‌ی «بیلی» ولسوالی بهسود و در «رودخانه کابل» رخ داده است. او گفته است که جسد این کودک هنوز مفقود است و تلاش برای پیدا کردن و بیرون کشیدن آن از آب جریان دارد. به‌گفته‌ی قریشی بدلون، این کودک باشنده‌ی اصلی ولایت کنر است و به‌تازگی همراه با خانواده‌اش از پاکستان اخراج و در ولسوالی بهسود ننگرهار مستقر شده بود. همه‌ساله در فصل بهار و تابستان، رویدادهای مشابه از ولایت‌های مختلف کشور گزارش می‌شود.

The Takshashila Institution, in partnership with the Bangalore International Centre (@bicblr), convened a debate on “Should India Ban Social Media for Children?” The discussion was structured in the Purva-Paksha format that emphasises presenting the opposing viewpoint before advancing one’s own argument. The tradition is rooted in the ancient Indian method of analytical reasoning. Nitin Pai (@acorn) argued in favour of the proposition, while Anupam Manur (@anupammanur) presented the opposing perspective. Moderated by Vanshika Saraf, the aim of the dialogue was not to win the debate but to understand the issue with greater clarity and depth.

Sipan Hemo: From the YPG to a Central Figure in Syria’s New Architecture 1/2 The appointment of Sipan Hemo as Deputy Minister of Defense for northeastern Syria, officially confirmed on March 10, immediately places him at the center of major security and political challenges. A former Commander-in-Chief of the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF), he is now tasked with a particularly sensitive mission: integrating Kurdish forces into the military apparatus of the new Syrian regime, while managing an unstable regional environment marked by tensions between Iran and Israel. From the very first weeks of his tenure, Hemo has been confronted with a series of attacks targeting military positions in the region. On March 29, the Qasrak base, located in the Kurdish governorate of Hasakah, was struck by drones launched from the Iraqi border. A few days earlier, on March 23, the Kharab al-Jir base had also come under rocket fire, though no casualties were reported, notably due to the prior withdrawal of U.S. forces in February. Hemo was quick to respond publicly, accusing Baghdad, via his new account on X, of failing to effectively control its territory. Now responsible for the Kurdish regions from a military standpoint, he must secure an area still exposed to incursions by pro-Iranian Iraqi militias, particularly active in the context of the conflict opposing Tehran and Tel Aviv since late February. Although relatively spared so far, eastern Syria remains vulnerable to these regional dynamics. Beyond the security dimension, however, Sipan Hemo plays a central role in a long-term political process: the integration of Kurdish forces into Syrian state structures. This project, formalized by an agreement concluded on January 29, had been negotiated following the fall of Bashar al-Assad in December 2024. At the time, Hemo was part of the team led by Mazloum Abdi, tasked with representing Kurdish interests vis-à-vis the new authorities in Damascus. This integration dynamic has also been reflected in symbolic appointments, such as that of Nourredin Issa Ahmed, a former SDF commander, who became governor of Hasakah in February, a first for a Kurd in Syria. However, this process unfolds in a personally difficult context for Hemo, marked by the death of his long-time ally Saleh Muslim, who passed away on March 11 in Erbil and was also expected to play a role in the new security architecture. On the ground, tensions remain high. Prior to the ceasefire negotiated under the auspices of U.S. envoy Tom Barrack, clashes between the SDF and forces stemming from Hayat Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), led by Ahmed al-Charaa, were nearly constant. In this context, Sipan Hemo’s profile appears to be an asset. Considered moderate and pragmatic, he embodies a conciliatory approach, in contrast to more controversial figures such as Azad Simi, head of SDF intelligence, who is viewed as too polarizing, particularly by Ankara. Turkey, a key supporter of HTS in its takeover of Damascus, remains strongly hostile to the SDF, which it equates with the PKK. Hemo must therefore cooperate with former adversaries, notably Awad al-Jassim, also known as Abu Qutaiba al-Manbiji, commander of the Syrian army’s 60th Brigade, in order to integrate Kurdish fighters into national military structures. His ability to defuse tensions has already been demonstrated, particularly in January, when he called for calm following the rapid loss of the Kurdish neighborhoods of Ashrafieh and Sheikh Maqsoud in Aleppo, thereby preventing a broader escalation. His role, however, extends beyond the strictly military dimension. Authorities in Damascus are also relying on him to mobilize the intelligence networks developed by the SDF over the past decade, particularly within local tribes. These networks are essential for stabilizing a region where the threat of the Islamic State remains latent, especially in camps where former fighters are detained.

No effort must be spared to swiftly reach, through diplomatic means, a strong and lasting settlement to the conflict in the Middle East. Such a settlement must provide the region with a robust framework enabling all to live in peace and security. To that end, all the core issues must be addressed through lasting solutions, whether with regard to Iran’s nuclear and ballistic activities, its destabilizing actions in the region, the need to restore free and unimpeded navigation through the Strait of Hormuz as quickly as possible, as well as the need to ensure that Lebanon returns to the path of peace in full respect of its sovereignty and territorial integrity. France stands ready to play its full part, as it has consistently sought to do since the very first day of the conflict. As regards the Strait of Hormuz, in the coming days, together with the United Kingdom, we will organize a conference with those countries prepared to contribute alongside us to a peaceful multinational mission aimed at restoring freedom of navigation in the strait. This strictly defensive mission, separate from the warring parties to the conflict, is intended to be deployed as soon as circumstances permit.

Aucun effort ne doit être ménagé pour parvenir rapidement à un règlement solide et durable du conflit au Moyen-Orient par la voie de la diplomatie. Un règlement qui permette de doter la région d’un cadre robuste permettant à chacun de vivre en paix et en sécurité. Pour y parvenir, toutes les questions de fond doivent être traitées en leur apportant une réponse durable, aussi bien s’agissant des activités nucléaires et balistiques de l’Iran que de ses actions déstabilisatrices dans la région, mais aussi pour permettre la reprise, le plus rapidement possible, d’une navigation libre et sans entrave dans le détroit d’Ormuz et faire en sorte que le Liban retrouve le chemin de la paix dans le plein respect de sa souveraineté et de son intégrité territoriale. La France est prête à y prendre toute sa part, comme elle s’y emploie avec constance depuis le premier jour du conflit. S’agissant du détroit d’Ormuz, nous organiserons avec le Royaume-Uni, dans les tout prochains jours, une conférence avec les pays prêts à contribuer à nos côtés à une mission multinationale pacifique destinée à restaurer la liberté de navigation dans le détroit. Cette mission strictement défensive et distincte des belligérants aura vocation à se déployer dès que la situation le permettra.

You unlocked your phone for just 12 minutes… and your iPhone quietly documented the entire session in a way most people would never expect. From a forensic analysis, the sequence becomes very clear. At exactly 2:58:30 PM, the device was unlocked. Almost immediately, at 2:58:33 PM, an application took focus and remained active without interruption. That application was Apple Maps, and it stayed in use continuously until 3:10:57 PM, when the device was locked again. No gaps, no switching, no background noise, just one sustained interaction lasting over 12 minutes. What makes this revealing is not just that an app was opened, but that the system captured a precise behavioral pattern. This tells a much deeper story. It suggests the user was actively navigating, searching for a location, or following a route during that exact timeframe. When you align this with other data sources like location history, messages, or call activity, it can place someone in motion, in a specific context, at a specific time. The part most people never consider is that none of this was manually saved. There’s no obvious history screen showing this level of detail, no prompt asking for permission to log it in this way. Yet the device recorded it anyway as part of its normal operation. To the average user, it feels like nothing happened. To a digital forensics investigator, it’s a clean, timestamped narrative of real-world activity. This is where perception and reality separate. People believe their phones only keep what they can see, but in truth, the system is constantly building context in the background. Not to expose you, but to function better. However, in the hands of an investigator, that same hidden context becomes evidence.

The Security Service of Ukraine has detained a Kharkiv resident suspected of collaborating with Russia. According to the investigation, she provided real-time guidance for a massive attack on Kharkiv on April 2, the SBU reported. Law enforcement officials claim that the detainee was guiding new Russian Geran-3 kamikaze drones toward Kharkiv online. This refers to the Russian attack on April 2, when the aggressor first used these drones against Kharkiv. The suspect was caught red-handed in a city park while she was livestreaming the second wave of UAV strikes on the city’s residential areas, according to the SBU. A smartphone with remote access for Russian intelligence officers was seized from her. Using this device, the enemy guided the Gerans toward apartment buildings in Kharkiv. The investigation established that the detainee is a local who was recruited by the Russians after her pro-Russian comments on Telegram channels. Following instructions from her Russian handler, the woman went to document the aftermath of the strikes immediately after the nighttime attack on the city, according to the SBU.

During their warm and cordial conversation, the two leaders discussed the recently held Islamabad Talks between the United States and Iran, hosted by Pakistan. Prime Minister Takaichi appreciated Pakistan’s diplomatic role in facilitating the ceasefire and talks. She expressed Japan’s full support for the peace process and its importance for regional stability and global energy security. While thanking the Japanese Prime Minister for her good wishes, the Prime Minister said that he was grateful to both the U.S. and Iranian delegations for their extensive discussions in Islamabad and said that Pakistan would continue with its efforts to ensure that the ceasefire is maintained. The Prime Minister expressed his desire to further strengthen Pakistan-Japan bilateral cooperation, which was reciprocated by the Japanese Prime Minister as well. Both leaders agreed to maintain close coordination.

राहुल गांधी जी ने एक साल पहले बीड़ा उठाया था कि देश में जातिगत जनगणना होकर रहेगी, लेकिन इसी मोदी सरकार ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट में हलफनामा देकर कहा था कि जातिगत जनगणना नहीं होनी चाहिए। यहां तक कि नरेंद्र मोदी कहते थे कि 'अर्बन नक्सल की सोच वाले लोग जातिगत जनगणना कराना चाहते हैं'। आखिर में मोदी सरकार ने जातिगत जनगणना कराने की बात मान ली। श्रीमती सोनिया गांधी जी ने अपने लेख में भी यही बात कही है कि मोदी सरकार लगातार जातिगत जनगणना से भागेगी। 2011 में आखिरी जनगणना हुई थी और फिर 2021 में जनगणना होनी थी। यानी- देश की जनगणना 5 साल पीछे चले रही है और डिजिटल जनगणना हो रही है तो उसके आंकड़ें 2027 तक आएंगे। सवाल है- बिना जनगणना के आंकड़ों के डिलिमिटेशन कैसे किया जा रहा है? जिन-जिन राज्यों में SIR हो रहा है, वहां लाखों-करोड़ों लोगों के नाम कटे हैं, यानी सरकार मान रही है कि अलग-अलग जगहों पर जनगणना बदल रही है। • ऐसे में किस आधार पर डिलिमिटेशन किया जाएगा? • सरकार कैसे फैसला लेगी कि SC/ST सीट कौन सी होंगी? बिहार और तेलंगाना में जातिगत सर्वे बताते हैं कि देश में पिछड़े वर्ग की जनसंख्या कितनी है और इसी आधार पर कांग्रेस पार्टी लगातार कहती रही है कि OBC महिलाओं के लिए दरवाजे खोलिए और आरक्षण दीजिए। लेकिन मोदी सरकार शकुनी चाल चलते हुए डिलिमिटेशन की प्रक्रिया को आगे बढ़ाती जा रही है, ताकि जातिगत जनगणना न करानी पड़े। : AICC सोशल मीडिया और डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म चेयरपर्सन @SupriyaShrinate जी 📍 दिल्ली Video

The conservative Tisza Party, led by Péter Magyar, has won Hungary’s parliamentary elections. Fidesz, the party of incumbent Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, lost after 16 years in power, according to the vote count released by Hungary’s National Election Office. On election day, a record turnout for Hungarian elections was recorded—as of 7:00 p.m. local time on April 12, 77.8% of voters, or over 5.8 million people, had cast their ballots, setting a historic record. In his victory speech, Magyar thanked his voters and emphasized that never before in Hungarian history had a party received a mandate like that of Tisza, nor had there been such a high voter turnout.

ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ 1919 ਨੂੰ ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਦੇ ਜਲਿਆਂਵਾਲਾ ਬਾਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ ਹਕੂਮਤ ਦੇ ਕਾਲੇ ਕਾਨੂੰਨ ‘ਰੋਲਟ ਐਕਟ’ ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਪ੍ਰਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਲਈ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਹੋਏ। ਸ਼ਾਮ 5:37 ਵਜੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਗੇਡੀਅਰ ਜਨਰਲ ਡਾਇਰ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮ 'ਤੇ ਤੰਗ ਰਸਤੇ ਰੋਕ ਕੇ ਨਿਹੱਥੇ ਪ੍ਰਦਰਸ਼ਨਕਾਰੀਆਂ 'ਤੇ ਸਿੱਧੀ ਫਾਇਰਿੰਗ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ। ਇਸ ਘਟਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸ਼ਹੀਦ ਹੋਏ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿੱਖ, ਹਿੰਦੂ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਨ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਸਨ। ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਲੈਫਟੀਨੈਂਟ ਗਵਰਨਰ ਮਾਈਕਲ ਓਡਵਾਇਰ ਨੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਗੇਡੀਅਰ ਜਨਰਲ ਡਾਇਰ ਦੇ ਇਸ ਜ਼ਾਲਮਾਨਾ ਹੁਕਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਮੁਕੰਮਲ ਹਮਾਇਤ ਕੀਤੀ। ਜਲਿਆਂਵਾਲਾ ਬਾਗ ਦੇ ਸਾਕੇ ਦਾ ਬਦਲਾ 21 ਸਾਲ ਬਾਅਦ ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਮਹਾਨ ਸਪੂਤ ਊਧਮ ਸਿੰਘ ਨੇ ਲਿਆ, ਜਦੋਂ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਮਾਈਕਲ ਓਡਵਾਇਰ ਨੂੰ ਲੰਡਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਤਲ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਤੇ ‘ਰਾਮ ਮੁਹੰਮਦ ਸਿੰਘ ਆਜ਼ਾਦ’ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਪਣਾ ਕੇ ਫਾਂਸੀ 'ਤੇ ਝੂਲ ਗਿਆ। ਜਲਿਆਂਵਾਲਾ ਬਾਗ ਹਿੰਦੁਸਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਆਜ਼ਾਦੀ ਲਈ ਪੰਜਾਬੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਮਹਾਨ ਜੱਦੋ-ਜਹਿਦ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਮਿਸਾਲ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਲੱਖਾਂ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੇ ਇਸ ਆਜ਼ਾਦੀ ਲਈ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਜਾਨਾਂ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ। ਅੱਜ ਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਜਲਿਆਂਵਾਲਾ ਬਾਗ ਦੇ ਮਹਾਨ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਸ਼ਹੀਦਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ!

بن‌بست در مذاکرات؛ ترامپ دوباره ایران را متهم کرد در ادامه تنش‌های دیپلماتیک، دونالد ترامپ بار دیگر ادعا کرد که ایران همچنان به دنبال دستیابی به سلاح هسته‌ای است؛ اظهاراتی که پس از پایان مذاکرات بدون نتیجه میان دو طرف مطرح شد. ترامپ در گفت‌وگو با خبرنگاران تأکید کرد: «ایران هنوز به دنبال این هدف است و ما اجازه نخواهیم داد به سلاح هسته‌ای دست پیدا کند.» او پیش از این نیز دلیل شکست مذاکرات را «عدم تمایل تهران به کنار گذاشتن برنامه هسته‌ای» عنوان کرده بود. در سوی دیگر، عباس عراقچی با ارائه روایتی متفاوت گفت که مذاکرات تا آستانه توافق پیش رفته بود، اما «حداکثرخواهی، تغییر مداوم شروط و فشارها» مانع نهایی شدن آن شد. این در حالی است که ناکامی این گفت‌وگوها، بار دیگر چشم‌انداز رسیدن به توافق میان دو کشور را با ابهام جدی روبه‌رو کرده و نگرانی‌ها درباره افزایش تنش‌ها را بیشتر کرده است.

Asked about Keir Starmer’s decisions during the war, Carlson dismissed the prime minister entirely, stating, “Keir Starmer is every bit as enslaved as Donald Trump is,” adding, “I feel sorry for him as I do for all slaves.” Carlson pointed directly to UK arrests linked to Palestine Action and broader restrictions around pro-Palestine expression, arguing this reflects a deeper political reality. “The British government has banned criticism of Israel. Therefore, it’s not sovereign,” he said. “Britain is not a sovereign country.” The BBC presenter rejected the framing and did not answer questions as to why Palestine Action was banned. Carlson extended the discussion to US policy, detailing that Washington had also been overruled in key moments. “The Israelis prevented us from getting out of it… therefore, they’re in charge,” Carlson said, pointing to the collapse of a ceasefire and continued escalation. This photograph preserves a breathtaking moment in the history of Chinese archaeology. The circular grey objects in the center are slices of lotus root. Dating from 160 BC, they had lain buried for over 2,100 years before being discovered in a vessel inside a tomb in present-day south China's Hunan Province. The image was taken just in time: once exposed to the air, the fragile remains quickly began to dissolve. Researchers later established that the lotus root had once been part of a soup dish buried with the tomb's owner, the widow of a marquis. As the summer heat intensifies across Myanmar, a sweet, drifting fragrance from the rows of Padauk trees begins to soothe the soul. This golden bloom is the herald of “Thingyan”—the announcement that the New Year is near. The word “Thingyan” is derived from the Sanskrit word Sankranta, meaning “Transition.” Just as the sun moves from Aries to Taurus, our lives transition from the old year into the new. The festival originates from a celestial wager between Thagyamin (King of Devas) and Arsi Brahma. To protect the world from destruction, the Brahma’s severed head is passed between seven goddesses each year; this handover marks the “Transition” we celebrate today. In Myanmar history, Thingyan has been a cornerstone of culture since the Bagan Era (AD 9th to 13th). Chronicles tell of King Narathihapate playfully splashing Queen Saw Lon with water, and later, during the Konbaung Dynasty, King Mindon hosted grand water festivals within the palace walls. The Myanmar Water Festival is not just a single event, but a spiritual journey through four distinct days: Akyo, Akya, Akat, and Atat. Each carries a unique tradition rooted in renewal and merit: - Thingyan Akyo (13 April): The day to prepare for and welcome the arrival of Thagyamin. Households set up the Atar Oh (Water Pot), decorated with seven types of auspicious leaves (such as Eugenia/Thabyay) to invite blessings into the home. - Thingyan Akya (14 April): The official descent of the King of Devas to Earth. The water splashing begins, symbolizing the washing away of the past year’s misfortunes. - Thingyan Akat (15 April): The “staying” days. Celebrations reach their peak with vibrant music and water throwing. (In some years, there are two Akat days). - Thingyan Atat (16 April): The final day and the “ascent” of the King of Devas. It is the last chance to wash away the “dirt” of the old year before the New Year arrives the following morning. Thingyan is a time for forgiveness and renewal. It is a reminder to wash away old grudges and step into the New Year with a pure heart and a fresh start.

Lots of weird takes on the Hungarian election result from both left and right here. Peter Magyar is a socially conservative immigration restrictionist who wants to cut taxes and double the defence budget. He criticized Orban for admitting too many guest workers, and wants to increase Hungary's already generous pro-natal incentives. On virtually every issue, his platform is well to the right of centre, by European standards. His foreign policy is to end Orban's alliance with Putin, remove the Hungarian veto on EU loans to Ukraine, normalize relations with the European Union while opposing more Euro integration, and strengthen relations with Eastern Europe's anti-Russian governments, e.g. Poland. His election was not a sudden shift to the left, but a rejection of Orban's corruption, the failure of his interventionist / statist economic policies, and the humiliation of his relationship with Putin.

The Trump administration seems to have miscalculated in Islamabad, assuming that Iran was weakened and ready to cave, when in fact it feels it has the upper hand. It's difficult to reach an agreement when both sides feel they have the advantage and are prone to overreach. And now Trump seems inclined to miscalculate again, assuming that blockading the Strait will force Iran to capitulate. That seems very unlikely. It's true that a blockade will put economic pressure on Tehran and on China, which in turn can put pressure on Iran. But with zero oil passing through the Strait, rising oil prices are likely to put even more pressure on Trump. Iran, as a dictatorship, simply has more strategic patience, and in addition there are many in Tehran who believe that Iran has to do more to reestablish deterrence and make the US pay a price. If the US blocks Iranian oil exports, expect Iran in turn to keep striking Fujairah, to keep the UAE from by passing the Strait by pipeline, and also to target Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline carrying oil to the Red Sea. And the Houthis are likely to counter-escalate by blocking oil exports through the Bab al-Mandab Strait as well. And that's not even counting possible strikes on oil refineries in the region. In short, I think Trump's escalation plans are once again characterized by magical thinking, false assumptions of Iranian weakness and a failure to think ahead about how Iran may respond to his moves. For Trump to escalate at this point will be a sign not of strength but of desperation, and counter to American and world interests.

NITI Aayog releases reports on “Ease of Doing Research & Development in India” NITI Aayog today released two reports titled “Ease of Doing Research & Development in India” and the “Survey Report on Ease of Doing R&D in India”, aimed at enabling a more efficient, facilitative, and innovation-driven research ecosystem in the country. The reports were formally released by Shri Suman Bery, Vice Chairman, NITI Aayog, and the Chief Guest Dr. Jitendra Singh, Minister of State (Independent Charge), Ministry of Science & Technology in the presence of Dr. V. K. Saraswat, Member, NITI Aayog, along with Secretaries of scientific departments, senior government officials, presidents of science academies, and representatives from academia and industry. Shri Suman Bery, Vice Chairman, NITI Aayog, in his address highlighted that translating research into practical applications remains a key priority. Dr. Jitendra Singh, Minister of State (Independent Charge), Ministry of Science & Technology, addressing the gathering, emphasised that the report is grounded in evidence and reflects the realities of the research ecosystem. Dr. V. K. Saraswat, Member, NITI Aayog, highlighted the diversity of institutional contexts across India’s research landscape while noting common challenges faced by researchers, spanning internal processes and external ecosystem factors such as funding, policy and regulatory frameworks. The reports provide a comprehensive assessment of India’s R&D ecosystem and outline actionable recommendations to strengthen funding, governance, regulatory frameworks, and research translation. They underscore the need for a more trust-based, outcome-oriented and facilitative environment to enable researchers and institutions to realise their full potential. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #ResearchAndDevelopment #EaseOfDoingR&D #InnovationEcosystem #ScienceAndTechnology #AtmanirbharBharat #ResearchReforms #IndiaInnovation #PolicyReforms #ViksitBharat

China emerging as a major loser of U.S. war with Iran: China’s supply chains are beginning to show signs of acute strain as the US war in Iran tests the limits of President Xi Jinping’s years-long effort to prepare his nation for external shocks. Sharp price increases and supply disruptionshave emerged across key products that form the backbone of Chinese industry. Beijing is now hoping that the ceasefire announced this week by US President Donald Trump and Iran can hold beyond the initial two weeks, allowing oil and gas to flow through the Strait of Hormuz & global trade to resume. Prices in China have doubled for some polyethylenes, disrupting the market for materials needed to make everything from plastic bags and bottles to clothing & toys. Prices for some carbon fibres, which rely on some feedstocks from the Middle East & are widely used across the auto & consumer goods industries, had risen 20%. The supply crunch is also hitting lower-end manufacturers. A shelf maker based in Wenzhou in eastern China said that, due to the recent surge in prices of raw materials, especially of “core plastics”, the company decided this month that it would have to raise prices for all new orders of certain products. Analysts and diplomats have warned that a protracted conflict could trigger further export bans on products including plastics, fertilizer blends & industrial inputs such as sulphuric acid as China’s supplies start to run thin. This could threaten foreign countries that rely on Chinese trade.

Also, if you’re in Abuja, consider visiting NASRDA, located around Airport Road in Lugbe. Visitations are allowed into the national museum and costs just ₦4,000. That gets you access to the national museum, a guided tour covering Nigeria’s space program history, models of our orbiting satellites, immersive VR experiences, interactive games, and a collection of fascinating artifacts. Last time I was there, the lady at the receptionist was telling me about a sort of astronomy based python programming course that they offer, but I never followed up on it. So yeah, they’ve got so much to offer. Please pay them a visit, I beg you in the name of Artemis II. Space exploration is a wonderful and humbling experience and there’s so much to learn and know. Wittig Lyon (@ibn_wittig) I totally understand you but Nigeria has a Space Program... and most people don’t even know how deep it goes. From launching satellites to planning human spaceflight this thread will surprise you. Nigeria runs its space missions through National Space Research and Development Agency (NASRDA). Established in 1999 and the goal was to put Nigeria on the global space map. Nigeria built her first satellite NigeriaSat-1 (2003). Although built in the UK and launched from Russia. But here’s the interesting part…NigeriaSat-1 wasn’t just for Nigeria. It joined the Disaster Monitoring Constellation and helping monitor floods, wildfires, and disasters worldwide. Nigeria is also a contributor to global space efforts. Even despite challenges, Nigeria didn’t stop there. More satellites followed: NigeriaSat-2 (high-resolution imaging) NigeriaSat-X (partly built by Nigerians ) NigComSat-1R (communications & internet) Not everything went smoothly by the way NigComSat-1 (2007) failed in orbit after about a year. But instead of stopping we came back stronger. In 2011, Nigeria launched NigComSat-1R, a replacement, better, improved system. That’s resilience most people don’t talk about. Here’s something you may find wild though Nigeria once planned to send an astronaut to space. Yes… a Nigerian in space. (It didn’t happen but the ambition was REAL.) So Nigeria is quietly using space tech daily: Communication (TV, internet), Agriculture monitoring, Mapping & GPS, Urban planning, Security You’re probably benefiting without realizing it. Nigeria has satellites in space but doesn’t launch rockets (yet). Launches are done via Russia, China, etc. Nigeria’s space story is just getting started. And one day… We might see 🇳🇬 launching rockets from its own soil. Maybe in our lifetime or not. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/ibn_wittig/status/2042994955791056901#m

OTD in 1945, Buchenwald Death Camp was liberated from the Nazis by American troops. Legendary newsman Edward R. Murrow was the first reporter on scene. This is how he began describing what he saw: "Permit me to tell you what you would have seen and heard had you had been with me on Thursday. It will not be pleasant listening ..." He then continued "There surged around me an evil-smelling stink. Men and boys reached out to touch me. They were in rags and the remnants of uniforms. Death had already had marked many of them, but they were smiling with their eyes." Murrow concluded: "I pray you to believe what I have said about Buchenwald. I reported what I saw and heard, but only part of it. For most of it, I have no words. If I have offended you by this rather mild account of Buchenwald, I'm not in the least sorry." Video

It has been such an honor to work with so many amazingly talented people Ian Miles Cheong (@ianmiles) Marc Andreessen highlights why the people who work for Elon Musk echo the exact same sentiment as those who worked for Steve Jobs. Even after difficult interactions or a sudden departure, they inevitably report that they did the best work of their entire lives because they were pushed to their absolute limits. What drives this intense environment is a demand for truth-seeking at all costs. People who criticize Elon often miss this fundamental trait. He genuinely wants to know the ground truth and has zero tolerance for anything else. When confronting bad news, he is absolutely ruthless and relentless in making sure he understands exactly what is actually going on. This level of radical transparency is shockingly rare in the business world. The typical startup founder operates on forced optimism, constantly putting on a brave face, telling everyone to have faith, and promising that everything will be great just to keep talent from leaving. Elon completely flips that standard script. He operates with pure urgency by simply telling the unfiltered truth, even when that truth is that the company will go bankrupt and die if they fail. In almost any other corporate environment, that level of blunt, existential dread would cause the talent pool to immediately bleed out. But for the teams working under him, that brutal honesty acts as the ultimate catalyst. It strips away the corporate fluff and forces them to rise to the occasion, leaving them with the undeniable realization that, much like the engineers who built the first iPhone, they just completed the greatest work of their careers. 🔴 ESTALLA SHEIMBAUN EN PALACIO NACIONAL : Me dice quien estaba ahí , que poco después de las 5 de la tarde del jueves pasado , la noticia cayó como un balde de agua helada en la oficina de la Presidenta, se reportaba un “incendio en la refinería Olmeca” y los primeros informes no eran claros, se tenían pocos datos , sin embargo Sheimbaun fue avisada de inmediato , y su primera reacción fue decir ; “ahora que que carajos pasó en Dos Bocas”, y pidió una comunicación inmediata con el Director General de Pemex , y con su amiga la titular de Energía, la versiones de ambos coincidían el incendio era en el “almacén” de una torre coquizadora en ese momento aún no se sabía su magnitud pero era en Dos Bocas , uno de los problemáticos proyectos de AMLO , el equipo de Sheimbaun inmediatamente empezó a “moverse” unos a construir una versión para el día siguiente en la mañanera y otros para saber hasta donde llegaba el daño . Pasada una hora y media , empezaron a llegar los reportes preocupantes , el incendio comprometía a la torre coquizadora , parte vital en la refinería y para su evaluación total Dos Bocas tenía que parar operaciones en algún momento. La Presidenta rechazó esta posibilidad ya que desde Palenque varias veces le han “solicitado” (ordenado) proteger a toda costa las mega obras así como su “buen desempeño” y más aún ahora que las noticias sobre la salud del expresidente NO han sido las mejores, de hecho se sabe en altos círculos de Morena que van más de dos veces que ha tenido que acudir a un hospital militar para atenderse. La decisión de la Presidenta fue que se hiciera lo que se pudiera pero sin detener los pocos procesos de Dos Bocas y menos ahora que su gobierno vive una de sus peores crisis . Sobre lo que diría en la Mañanera la sugerencia de los “expertos” venezolanos era que se minimizara el evento , lo que generó molestia y alguna renuncia en el área de comunicación social de Pemex , y que como ya es notorio y usual que Sheimbaun mantuviera una “sonrisa” que contrasta con su permanente mal humor, enojo , regaños y frustración , y que solo se permitirá hacer una sola pregunta “light” sobre el “evento” en la mañanera del día siguiente (viernes) , buscando que el tema principal fuera el mundial de fútbol , el “fútbol social’ y los boletos para el mundial . Como siempre la mañanera la “operó” RC, quien debe cuidar al pie de la letra la orden dada varias veces por AMLO . Sin embargo tanto en Hacienda como en Energía y Pemex saben bien que las mega obras del “señor de Palenque” son insostenibles y no sólo financieramente hablando sino también desde el lado de la seguridad ; el tren Maya se hunde literalmente y será imposible evitar que los pilotes del tramo 5 se mantengan firmes esto ya se sabe en Palacio Nacional , también se saber Dos Bocas es una bomba de tiempo si no se detiene y se revisa, el AIFA no despega y Mexicana pierde dinero . Estas obras ya costaron más se 1.1 billones de pesos y su pérdida aumenta cada día , pero su costo más importante serán las vidas humanas que se pierdan en una tragedia que NO está lejos si la Presidenta NO se enfrenta con AMLO y detiene estos caprichos . Pero le han vuelvo a llamar para recordarle que está obligada a defenderlos. Sheimbaun vuelve a quedar frente al dilema de ser rehén o cómplice , su salida sería la renuncia , como dicen sus “cercanos” que cada vez son menos , si una tragedia mayor sucediera de aquí a la elección del 27 , a ella seria la culpable y Morena perdería las elecciones. Las pérdidas financieras hasta hoy las ha cubierto con endeudamiento y ahora con las Afores , pero las pérdidas políticas las pagaría perdiendo millones de votos . Y eso también lo saben en Palenque, por ello para la 4T y para Sheinbaum la narrativa mentirosa y fantasiosa se vuelve cada día más importante , en los próximos meses este será el tema más importante , el control del estado de todo y para todos . Pero la tragedia está latente . México es una bomba de tiempo y este se agota.

🔴 URGENTE AL MINUTO : Asesores en comunicación venezolanos toman el control del área de comunicación social de @Pemex hay mucho hermetismo en la petrolera sobre la magnitud del daño en la “coquizadora” de la Refinería Olmeca y la viabilidad de su operación, es un hecho que el complejo se encuentra comprometido es muy posible que en 2 semanas se tenga que detener totalmente para revisar, hacer pruebas y valoraciones , de no hacerlo así podrían venir eventos más graves y destructivos, de hecho podría estallar.

This is a smart piece in @WarOnTheRocks on the nature of strategic rivalry vs competition. I tend to agree with it & will modify my vocabulary going forward regarding #China, which is quite obviously a rival. warontherocks.com/2026/04/wh… One thing that is key is prioritization & focus. I think the US has allowed itself for too long to be distracted from the most critical rivalry which is China. #Russia is a lesser rival, & as I have long argued possibly can be converted into a competitor instead & triangulating pivot player relative to China with the right American strategy. #Iran is clearly a rival but less important to the US than China. The US should have leveraged regional actors to squeeze it over time instead of getting distracted from the Pacific. All that said, I still think that the below excerpt is good. "Rivals play for higher stakes. They do not just compete. They endeavor to weaken each other or worse. Strategic rivalries are basically serial wars and strategic rivals are repeat offenders — literally the usual suspects. When dealing with America’s three strategic rivals, U.S. strategists need to understand two things: None of America’s rivals appears willing to deescalate at the moment and one has already drawn the United States into yet another armed conflict. This cycle will repeat itself unless U.S. strategists find ways to reduce the respective capacities of America’s rivals to compete. The United States needs a strategy that will knock its rivals out of the game and break the cycle though not necessarily by taking on all three at once or by doing so alone. America needs a comprehensive strategy that combines containment and preclusion. Containment amounts to applying coercive pressure to erode a rival’s capacity to compete, leading to an economic or political collapse similar to that of the Soviet Union during the Cold War. Preclusion calls for positioning U.S. forces where they can best deny a rival the resources it needs to continue competing. In some ways, the United States is reducing Iran’s military capacity to compete, especially regarding nuclear arms, through Operation Epic Fury. But to avoid simply 'mowing the grass,' that is, removing a regime’s leadership and reducing some of its military capabilities, this operation should be tied to a larger strategy of containment or preclusion, or both. Otherwise, Iran will reconstitute and another operation will have to be launched but the circumstances may make it more difficult next time."

For decades, a racist equation was quietly built into the US medical system. The eGFR—a formula used to measure kidney function—automatically inflated scores for Black patients based on the false assumption that Black people have more muscle mass. This made their kidneys appear healthier than they actually were, delaying diagnosis, treatment, and access to life-saving transplants, costing many their lives while waiting. Dr. Joel Bervell, a Ghanaian-American doctor, used his social media platform to expose this dangerous racial bias in medicine, sparking a nationwide conversation that led to the equation being changed in 2022. Black patients’ wait times were recalculated, and 21,000 lives were saved as a result.
